chapter.12.quest.76.task.6.title: 12x Polished Pillars
chapter.12.quest.76.task.7.title: 24x Polished Slabs
chapter.12.quest.76.task.8.title: 159x Polished Blocks
chapter.12.quest.76.title: The Enchanter
chapter.12.quest.77.description.1: Need help &5Visualizing&r the multiblocks? For the &aPedestal&r there is a button in the GUI to toggle the &5Visualization&r, but for others, right-clicking should do the trick!
chapter.12.quest.77.task.1.title: Click to Acknowledge
chapter.12.quest.77.title: Visualize the Future
chapter.12.quest.78.description.1:
Whenever you pick up one of those &alittle green orbs&r that appear whenever you &ckill&r an enemy, you get smarter &osupposedly&r.


However, the inevitable death by &cclumsiness&r means that you always lose this &aexperience&r quickly. Crystallized and safely stored in your chests, however, they will be as safe as can be.


A &bKnowledge Gem&r can hold up to &a10,000 experience&r. &dEnchanting&r it with &eEfficiency&r increases that limit, &6Quick Charge&r boosts the pushing / pulling of &axp&r.
chapter.12.quest.79.description.1:
You already thought that the moment you put the recipe on paper that this creation will be something special.


The combination of the power of the &5End&r, &credstone&r, and &dmagic&r gives it &cvery strange&r properties.


Depending on the strength of the applied &credstone signal&r, this block takes on &edifferent properties&r. Without &credstone&r, it is completely solid; when a &credstone signal&r reaches it, it becomes transparent, almost like glass. 


However, it reaches its most curious state when a &credstone&r signal of &6full strength&r is applied...


To make it even stranger, &aEnder Glass&r seems to respond to the last applied signal alone, not the strongest.


Truly a curiosity from the &5End&r.
chapter.12.quest.8.description.1: The &bCompacting Chest&r will try to craft all the things you put into it in a &e3x3, 2x2, or 1x1 pattern&r. This can be toggled in its &dGUI&r.
chapter.12.quest.80.description.1:
Placing an &5Ender Chest&r, opening it, and mining it with an &denchanted pickaxe&r is not what you think of as fun. That's why you invented this thing.


You can open the &aBag of Holding&r to get access to your personal &5Ender Chest&r wherever you are!
chapter.12.quest.81.description.1:
If you place the &aSugar Stick&r so that its underside is &9immersed&r in &bLiquid Crystal&r, you can grow your own &eRock Candies&r! You must drop &7Sugar&r into the &bLiquid Crystal&r to start the process.


You may even be able &5to add other stuff than just plain &7Sugar&r.
chapter.12.quest.81.subtitle: Goodbye teeth
chapter.12.quest.81.task.1.title: Sugar Sticks
chapter.12.quest.81.task.2.title: Rock Candies
chapter.12.quest.81.title: Rock Candies
chapter.12.quest.82.description.1:
You had more than enough time to develop your own individual fighting style. To best support this style, you've designed a range of &ematching gear&r out of &dinteresting materials&r.


&cDisadvantage&r: The shards used in the production are kind of brittle. Therefore, this equipment has a comparatively low durability. They can be &erepaired&r in &aAnvils&r by using &dGemstone Shards&r.


To take advantage of their unique properties, you will need some unique materials:
- &aHelmet&r: &oWhen nothingness meets &cHell&r
- &aChestplate&r: &oThe &eGolden Ratio&r
- &aLeggings&r: &oThe source of &5nightmares&r
- &aBoots&r: Mourning of the &cNether&r


Once you have obtained those materials, you can make the &ecorresponding piece of armor&r


&l&bFetchling Helmet&r
Gives attackers &dWeakness&r and &aSlowness&r when they hit you, letting you slip through their claws like a shadow.


&l&bFerocious Chestplate&r
Grants &eAbsorption&r and &6Resistance&r when you get hit, making you a massive wall for a short duration.


&l&bSylph Leggings&r
Gives you a short burst of &cRegeneration&r on hit, making you get right back up after each hit.


&l&bOread Boots&r
Gives a short burst of &aSpeed&r and &dInvisiblity&r when you get hit, giving you an opportunity to retreat. Perfect for ranged combat.
chapter.12.quest.82.title: Gemstone Armor
chapter.12.quest.83.description.1: Not just the bags under your eyes that are evidence of your lack of sleep. There are those &dcreatures&r that come haunt you straight out of your missed nightmares when you don't regularly lie down to sleep - almost like they feel cheated. This here is the manifestation of &erelaxation&r, no sleep necessary. After just a few minutes of wear, you feel physically and mentally refreshed. You also recover from &cnegative effects&r more quickly.
chapter.12.quest.84.description.1:
Your pickaxe, which was sinfully expensive to &denchant&r, almost broken and each additional broken blocks hurts your nerves more than the tool itself? May the tool not be able to be rescued, at least the &dEnchantments&r will! This &aCanvas&r can not only capture color: Used on a tool, the &dEnchantments&r are exchanged.


Once used, an image of the item you used it on will be drawn on the &aCanvas&r. You can then apply those &dEnchantments&r on another tool.
chapter.12.quest.85.description.1:
Designed resembling an ordinary &ehopper&r in form and function, the &5Ender Hopper&r has the special ability to put all items above it and from inventories directly into your &dEnder Chest&r.


The &5Ender Hopper&r only works while you are online.
chapter.12.quest.86.description.1:
The &5Ender Dropper&r is the counterpart to the &5Ender Hopper&r. With every &credstone pulse&r it ejects an item from your personal &dEnder Chest&r.


&cBeware&r: The &5Ender Dropper&r only works as long as you are online. And who is stopping anyone from placing a button next to it and emptying your &dEnder Chest&r?
chapter.12.quest.87.description.1: The ends of this pickaxe are studded with &bTopaz&r to cut even the most delicate material from stone. The &aTender Pickaxe&r comes pre-enchanted with &dSilk Touch&r.
chapter.12.quest.88.description.1:
You must be careful when freeing the &dmicroorganisms&r in the &aBottle of Failing&r as they are ravenous. They will spread to connecting blocks over time and consume the block entirely. 


They have a &especial interest&r in eating &5a certain black block that was once &clava&r.
chapter.12.quest.88.title: A New Material
chapter.12.quest.89.description.1:
The &dObsidian&r was literally pulverized. This is what you call &cpower&r!


The result was this sturdy &areagent&r. Very powerful!
chapter.12.quest.9.description.1: To advance, you must get acquainted with the &acrafting process&r. Pick an item you can craft with the &bPedestal&r, input the required &eitems and powders&r and then right-click with a &dPaintbrush&r or apply a &credstone signal&r to start the craft.
chapter.12.quest.9.title: Your First Craft
chapter.12.quest.90.description.1:
The most interesting thing about the &dEndermen&r is, without question, their &eteleportation&r ability. You were pretty successful replicating it! However, to determine the destination of the teleport, you must first take a snapshot of the position. &o&dEndermen&f don't have to do that - why?&r 


A &climitation&r of the &aEnder Splice&r is that it can only be used in the &bsame dimension it is bound to&r.


&l&eUsage&r
By charging it with a long right-click, you bind it to your current position. The second use will teleport you back to that original location. &eIt can even be used on other players&r.


&dEnchanting&r an &aEnder Splice&r with &5Unbreaking&r by using the &bEnchanter&r decreases the chance of it breaking on use.
chapter.12.quest.91.description.1: By infusing &dNeolith&r with a glove you've been able to produce the &aGloves of Dawn's Grasp&r. These &aGloves&r &eincrease your reach&r. You can further extend your reach by infusing it with even more &bBlue Ink&r.
chapter.12.quest.92.description.1:
The latest findings from your last experiment make you strive for more and more. Squeeze every last ounce of energy out of your &dgemstones&r.


&5Neolith&r is the key! Yes, it is must be! If you combine all the gems you have collected so far with it, something must be created that holds &eincredible power&r. Alone for you and ONLY for you, master of &dpigment&r!


Fusing those &dmagical energies&r must result in an incredible source of power - with a display to match. Best to make sure your &aShrine&r and everything around it is fortified. &o&lI'm not kidding, make sure nothing important is near your &aShrine&f, expect a &ccleanup&r. You can use &3Polished Calcite&r / &ePolished Basalt&r to protect the area.


When you're ready, put &dAmethyst&r, &eCitrine&r, &bTopaz&r, &dOnyx&r, and &5Neolith&r shards in a &aFusion Shrine&r alongside some &dLiquid Crystal&r during a clear day.


&cRequires daytime and a clear sky&r.
chapter.12.quest.92.title: Unstable and Dangerous
chapter.12.quest.93.description.1:
This abomination of a &dGemstone&r radiates an eerie aura.


It looks closely connected at best. No wonder it &cfalls apart in your hands&r in no time. Total failure.


While the chaos that ensued &odefinitely&r was not the outcome you craved for, the result still does hold immense power. So much in fact, that if not used quick it crumbles into dust. And then there is that &eaggressive blackish fluid&r that manifested in the process. Because of its color you named it &aMidnight Solution&r.
chapter.12.quest.94.description.1: The liquid which was created during the creation of the &aMidnight Aberration&r... it &cdamages&r everything it touches. It seems to have varying effects depending on what lands in it. Enchanted items lose their &dmagical powers&r, and some items change altogether. However, most interesting is that &bcreatures killed by it&r drop a &emysterious fragment&r.
chapter.12.quest.94.title: It's not Oil
chapter.12.quest.95.description.1:
Creatures that die in &aMidnight Solution&r drop &bMidnight Chips&r. These resemble the &eMidnight Aberration&r you failed to create before, just way, way smaller. 


Creatures killed by this process also seem to &edrop items as if they were killed by a player&r.
chapter.12.quest.96.description.1: This strange blocks let your &evision penetrate ground and rock&r. Placed directly on a wall or on the ground, it allows you to glimpse the other side.
chapter.12.quest.97.description.1:
&cFiery Powder&r can be obtained by crushing &4Blazing Crystals&r (and less efficiently, &cMagma Blocks&r).


It will be a useful crafting material in the future.
chapter.12.quest.98.description.1: As &9water&r tried to flow to a full block of &aLiquid Crystal&r the crystal turned solid. Since even a light touch is enough to give you a &bcold shiver&r, you call it &bFrostbite Crystal&r.
chapter.12.quest.99.description.1: Crushing &bFrostbite Crystal&r with an anvil yields this ice cold powder, which almost makes your hand freeze just by holding it. Crushing &9Ice&r seems to work too, albeit with much less yield.
chapter.12.subtitle: Is that you Merasmus?
chapter.12.title: &aSpectrum: World of Magic&r
chapter.13.quest.1.description.1:
You have accomplished what you set out to do. You have broken free of the confines of the &aoverworld&r.


But your experiment has raised more questions than answers. You have found evidence of &blong-dead civilizations&r beneath the bedrock. 


Who were they? 
What killed them? 
What did they have to do with your quest?


&oThe only way to answer these questions is to explore this new world.&r


&l&6&oThe plot thickens...&r&r&r


This section of &dSpectrum&r is heavily focused on exploring &oeverything&r in the &aDeeper Down&r. If you find you can't see the recipe for the next item in the quest book, &btry delving into other questlines&r.
chapter.13.quest.1.subtitle: The Beginning of the End
chapter.13.quest.1.task.1.title: Enter the Deeper Down
chapter.13.quest.1.title: Spectrum: Turn to Purity
chapter.13.quest.10.description.1: Exploring the &6Deeper Down&r at the lowest levels, you may come across ruins of a digsite of somesort. Maybe these will hold the secrets to destroying &aDownstone&r?
chapter.13.quest.11.description.1:
At the deepest parts of the &6Deeper Down&r, this stone was waiting for you. Immensely hard, even &cbedrock&r is a laugh compared to it.


That never stopped you before, maybe there's a way to break through?
chapter.13.quest.11.title: Downstone
chapter.13.quest.12.title: Is it "kite" or "chite"?
chapter.13.quest.13.description.1: There's a new ore that can be found in the end. Make sure you're &aready to catch it&r!
chapter.13.quest.13.title: Secrets of the End
chapter.13.quest.14.description.1:
The &blight blue color&r is the trademark of this ore. It is found exclusively in &dThe End&r in small clusters.


Like &dThe End&r itself, the curious properties of this material are not to be overlooked.
chapter.13.quest.15.description.1: &aMalachite&r is a pristine material that sparkles in a deep green hue. It seems to have strong magical properties, almost like a &6Deeper Down&r analog of &9Azurite&r.
chapter.13.quest.16.description.1: With your new &dSpectrum Palace&r, you can finally round out the last three pigments you have not been able to create up to this point.
chapter.13.quest.16.title: Shades of Gray
chapter.13.quest.17.description.1:
Every time you want to enter the realm of the Endermen, you have to travel half a world over. However, you are much more powerful now than those who created the portals. Well, almost... Probably. You still haven't figured out how to create such portals yourself, but packing them up and taking them home? No problem.


Due to how sturdy the portal frames are, you might want to take a step back after setting the Perturbed Eye, as it might get a bit rough.
chapter.13.quest.18.description.1:
It looks &cred-hot&r, as if it were on fire, burning like hell to the touch (you just had to satisfy your curiousity...) and yet radiates no heat at all. While &dMidnight Solution&r seems to be destructive for the sake of change, &cDragonrot&r seems intent only on pure and total destruction. Certainly there is not much organic that can withstand its bloodlust.


Throwing in some items seems to &3corrupt&r them up to the point they turn into something else entirely...
chapter.13.quest.18.title: Dragonrot
chapter.13.quest.19.description.1:
In some of the Forgotten Cities you will find a large structure made of Preservation Stone with a Dike barrier at the front. Inside are deadly turrets and other rarities. 


The item to complete this quest are located deep within, or dropped from the turrets themselves.
chapter.13.quest.2.description.1:
You've dug deep to get here, but you must dig deeper.


Nearing the &bbottom of this new world&r you find yourself in, a &anew precious stone&r sits. Find the shimmering stones in this pit of darkness. 


&oIf you found the ore, but haven't had the item revealed to you yet, try finding the geode for it!&r
chapter.13.quest.2.title: Moonstone Sonata
chapter.13.quest.20.description.1:
You may or may not have come across one of the &dPreservation Ruins&r up to this point, however there was a secret locked away due to your lack of ability to make grayscale colors. 


With &aMoonstone Powder&r, you can now obtain this special locket.
chapter.13.quest.21.description.1:
A metal that shimmers in all the colors of the rainbow. The small seedlings you collected are far &ctoo small&r to be used for any meaningful purpose.


How do they grow without a &ebudding block&r? One thing you noticed: &ait slightly grew in proximity of other metals&r.
chapter.13.quest.22.description.1:
Growing your first &aBismuth Crystals&r requires placing a &dBismuth Bud&r onto a cluster of &bIron Blocks&r. 


Luckily, you only have to do this &eonce&r, and afterward you unlock recipes to make crystals without sacficiing &bIron Blocks&r.
chapter.13.quest.23.description.1: Be careful transporting a lot of &bPaltaeria&r, you might be in for a surprise!
chapter.13.quest.23.title: Taking Flight
chapter.13.quest.24.description.1: From your previous experiences with &bPaltaeria&r, you can already guess that it would not be a good idea to place htis block in open sky - your future self will thank you.
chapter.13.quest.25.description.1:
&bPaltaeria Gems&r are incredibly rare drops from mining the ore. Unlike the fragments, the gems can be used in recipes where the fragments would be too small to suffice.


Mining a &esingle gem&r is required for unlocking the recipe to craft more gems.
chapter.13.quest.26.description.1: The problem with &dOnyx Shards&r is that their creation is tied to very specific conditions. It is not every day that there is a new moon. Every time you look at the clock, the window of time seems to have just passed by for two minutes. Time to break out the big guns: &dMagenta's affinity for time...&r
chapter.13.quest.27.description.1:
The &aResonant Pickaxe&r matches its own gentle vibrations to those of its surroundings. It allows you to keep blocks intact that would otherwise be &eirreparably destroyed&r.


Try it out on &bbudding blocks&r and &2spawners&r!
chapter.13.quest.28.description.1:
With budding blocks in mind you designed the &dCrystallarieum&r: an &eInk-powered&r contraption that grows chunks of raw ore into sparkling crystals. Though your best efforst failed to grow actual gems, you quickly realized that it could grow all sorts of other resources instead.


Throw &6raw ore&r on top to let it &bcrystallize into a Bud&r, able to be grown.


Growing resources requires:
- a &aCatalyst&r
- one color of &bInk&r, supplied via &2Flask&r. The color of ink is indicated when hovering over the &dCrystallarieum&r in &5REI&r or by the color the block turns once you place the initial bud material down.


&aCatalysts&r
Each catalyst has a different effect on bud growth: while one catalyst may reduce the required amount of ink, another may alter the duration of the process...


&6Metals vs. Crystals&r
Metallic resources require unrefined materials such as Raw Iron, resulting in a Small Iron Bud that will grow steadily until it can be safely harvested.


For crystalline resources, an existing crystal can be used as a seed to grow identical copies of itself.


&cWarning&r: There's a bit of a bug with the &dCrystallarieum&r at the moment where it will &ccontinue to consume resources&r past what it should. Try only leaving the ink in for a &afew seconds&r before taking it out, otherwise you might lose all your ink!
chapter.13.quest.29.description.1:
&aMalachite&r also needs to be refined. The small fragments you obtain must first grow into full usable crystals - though you're not sure you'll seem them finished in your lifetime.


&aMalachite&r as a material seems perfect for tools, best compared to &bDiamond&r, but much easier to combine with other materials. These combinations are where the fun begins, allowing for some uniquely intricate tools.


&oIf you don't immediately know the solution, I recommend exploring the other quests in the Deeper Down.&r
chapter.13.quest.3.description.1:
These &bformerly unknown shards&r can be used to improve your &aPigment Pedestal&r even further.


To harness their power fully, you will need to upgrade your &eSpectrum Temple&r to a &6Spectrum Palace&r. The quest requirements are the materials you will need to do this upgrade. You can use the &3World of Color book&r to plant a visualization of where the blocks will need to go.


Place a single &bMoonstone Shard&r in the &dPigment Table&r to start the conversion.
chapter.13.quest.3.task.1.title: 4x Onyx Chiseled Blocks
chapter.13.quest.3.task.2.title: 4x Polished Gemstone Blocks
chapter.13.quest.3.task.3.title: 36x Polished Crests
chapter.13.quest.3.task.4.title: 12x Polished Blocks
chapter.13.quest.3.title: Incandescence
chapter.13.quest.30.description.1: The &aWorkstaff&r is the perfect Multitool: Left Shift + Right Click allows you to switch between &dSilk Touch&r and &5Fortune&r, mining large tunnels at once, and allows you to strip, till, and flatten.
chapter.13.quest.31.description.1: The &aUltra Greatsword&r's sheer size allows you to hit enemies from greater distance. If you hadn't included the &bPaltaeria&r, you probably wouldn't even be able to lift it.
chapter.13.quest.32.description.1:
The &aBident&r is a true powerhouse when dealing with aquatic creatures.


It may have only two prongs compared to a &bTrident&r, but they are twice as pointy!
chapter.13.quest.33.description.1: The &aMalachite Crossbow&r shoots projectiles at higher speed and precision compared to a mundane Crossbow
chapter.13.quest.34.description.1:
This glistening hoop creates a protective film of air around you.


Grants you 4 points of &9Azure Dike&r. Using those charges, it not only protects you from enemy projectiles, but can even cushion a long fall. The &aPuff Circlet&r also prevents farmland from being trampled.
chapter.13.quest.35.description.1:
Right clicking a socketed &bMoonstone Locket&r will provide you with this compass.


It looks to point towards something in the &dDeeper Down&r...
chapter.13.quest.36.description.1:
This marks the current end of &dSpectrum&r progression :(


If you enjoyed your time playing through this mod, please support the devs on Ko-fi if you can.
chapter.13.quest.36.subtitle: A Journey's End
chapter.13.quest.36.task.1.title: Find your goal
chapter.13.quest.37.description.1:
For all those wo don't either live in a simple &7Cobblestone&r house or live without walls entirely - of course you don't feel addressed - you have thought up the &aExchanging Staff&r.


Enchanting an &aExchanging Staff&r with &dResonance&r by using the &5Enchanter&r will give it the power to harvest some special blocks as-is.
chapter.13.quest.38.description.1:
To make &aBone Ash&r, you'll need a &bCinderhearth&r as it's the only thing that can get hot enough to burn the bones into ash.


&aBone Ash&r is used for decoration and potions.
chapter.13.quest.39.description.1:
&bMoonstone Cores&r are bursting with energy. It sounds like a very bad idea to discharge on within milliseconds.


&o...but sometimes the worst ideas are the best, aren't they?&r


Their explosion &cdoes not damage blocks&r, but causes &aimmensely aggressive fire&r.
chapter.13.quest.4.description.1:
Your latest structure feels... somewhat lacking. And now you know why: There's simply not enough &aMoonstone&r. The tricky part is that creating the &bMoonstone Chiseled Blocks&r to build out your &dSpectrum Palace&r would require the&d Palace &rto be fully functional already. 


&oPerhaps there is a way to get around that? If you haven't already found the solution, you should continue exploring the &6Deeper Down&r for the trails left by those before you.&r
chapter.13.quest.4.title: Something's Missing...
chapter.13.quest.40.description.1:
So much for your plans for a personal jurassic park. &oMaybe a petting zoo would be more suitable&r? 


The result definitely is not quite as... &cfierce&r... as you imagined. Usually you'd say you are used to failures by now, but with this result, who are you to complain?


Their down looks beyond soft. Maybe, if you sneak up to one with &eshears&r, you'd be able to &bsnip a feather or two&r?
chapter.13.quest.41.description.1: The &aDragonrending Pickaxe&r is a real powerhouse of a pick for when you want to break &chard blocks&r. It comes pre-enchanted with &dRazing&r, which &3increases&r your mining speed depending on the &2hardness&r of the block
chapter.13.quest.42.description.1: Hard, sharp and yet surprisingly brittle. These stones are found everywhere in the &eRazor Edge&r biome. Unless &dsilk touched&r, &6Pyrite&r shatters into items, requiring you to combine them again.
chapter.13.quest.43.description.1:
This small blade is too fine to inflict serious wounds, but has many sharp spikes that drill themselves into the flesh of your opponent.


Infused in the &6Potion Workshop&r, all struck opponents are afflicted with the effect - provided you have enough&b Ink &ron you.
chapter.13.quest.44.description.1:
Mining is your game. It's almost a mircale that you're only now coming up with the idea of upgrading not only your tools, but your mining proficiency in general. This ring will grow with your abilities.


Infuse it with &dMagenta Ink&r in a &6Color Picker&r to increase your &amining speed&r.
chapter.13.quest.45.description.1:
The &aStaff of Remembrance&r allows you to move around your animals with ease, both short and long distance.


Tap an animal to collect them as a &dMemory&r.
chapter.13.quest.46.description.1: This upgrade to the &aWorkstaff&r allows you to&e Right Click&r to shoot out &fWhite Ink&r which will break blocks on impact. You can also choose from &dResonance&r when switching enchantments.
chapter.13.quest.47.description.1: This upgrade to the &aUltra Greatsword&r deals a chunk of its damage via &dMagic&r, which pierces armor. Right Click to charge a &eground slam&r, knocking back everything around you. This ability scales with &6Sweeping Edge&r.
chapter.13.quest.48.description.1: The &aFerocious Bident&r is the result of combining a &bBident&r and a &3Pocket Thunderstorm&r. Hurl yourself into the air and damage everything in your path, even in the driest of deserts! Well, that is if you don't run out of &dink&r... The ability scales with the level of &5Riptide&r.
chapter.13.quest.49.description.1: The &aFractal Bident&r is combined with &dEcho Shards&r to make it throw an echo version that shatters upon impact while the original will never leave your hand.
chapter.13.quest.5.description.1:
There is no question that, despite the lack of light, there must once have been a highly &aadvanced civilization&r down here. But all you found were ruins.


Thankfully, you can repurpose the &eMoonstone Chiseled Blocks&r found in their temple to further your own goals. 


But what happened to them? Surely you can find clues to their whereabouts, or demise.
chapter.13.quest.5.task.1.title: Moonstone Chiseled Blocks
chapter.13.quest.5.title: Remnants from the Past
chapter.13.quest.50.description.1: If an arrow is loaded, you can &2overcharge&r the shot by holding Left Shift + Right Button to increase your shot's &baccuracy&r, &espeed&r, and &cdamage&r even further.
chapter.13.quest.51.description.1: Socketing &bMoonstone Cores&r into your &aMalachite Tools&r grants them powerful new abilities.
chapter.13.quest.51.task.1.title: Glass Crest Tools
chapter.13.quest.52.description.1:
A ribbon, gifted to pets as an &beverlasting promise&r to watch out and care for them. Name it and attach it on a creature. Should it ever &cdie&r it will drop a &aBroken Promise&r. Basically if your pet dies you get it back as a &eMemory&r that can be manifested later.


You can use a &bCrafting Table&r to add a &3Pigment&r to the &6Ribbon&r to give your pet a colored name.
chapter.13.quest.53.description.1:
&eAmpuoules&r can be used as combat tools, which their effect varies based on the material to make them.


&bAzurite Ampoules&r summons homing missiles that attack the nearest enemy.
&cBloodstone Ampoules&r summon arrows that pierce through enemies.
&aMalachite Ampoules&r create mines that you can put a potion effect on using a &6Potion Workshop&r.
chapter.13.quest.53.title: Ampoules
chapter.13.quest.54.description.1: The &aCirclet of Arrogance&r gives you the &4Ascension&r buff in wearable form. If your mere existence wasn't in danger every time you get hit too hard, you would not hesitate for a second to put it on. &o&bBut should you really...&r&r? &c&lOf course&r&r.
chapter.13.quest.54.subtitle: Test Your Hubris
chapter.13.quest.55.description.1:
Even in death, the grand skeletal remains of &bdragons&r that dot the depths bear so much might and life to them. There must be some way to recreate their splendor via those &7Dragonbone Chunks&r.


Maybe you will be the one to restore the age of divine dragons?


Checking &dREI&r for this recipe is a bit difficult, so I'll include it here. In your &6Spirit Instiller&r, from left to right, use the following:
- &78x Dragonbone Chunk&r
- &a4x Vegetal&r / &d4x Neolith&r
- &b1x Jade Petals&r / &31x Jadeite Petals&r
chapter.13.quest.55.subtitle: How to Train Your Dragon
chapter.13.quest.55.title: Memory of Kindling
chapter.13.quest.56.description.1: The &aEffulgent Feathers&r of the &eKindlings&r are notable, enough so to compel you to regularly give the little bumpkins coat trimmings. However, you've noticed that, sadly quite frequently, drops of blood will come along with the features. When dipped into &6Liquid Crystal&r, it leaves behind a sparkly crystalline residue.
chapter.13.quest.57.description.1: Set upon the &dCrystallarieum&r and given a precarious amount of &cCopper&r, the speck of &4dragonblood&r will grow and crystallize into a grand slab of glass, shining in stunning scarlet and bleeding with willful magic!
chapter.13.quest.58.description.1: Using these feathers over regular chicken feathers you can imbue your arrows with &eeven more power&r. These razor-sharp arrows deal increased damage, can be fired underwater and can pierce translucent blocks such as Glass. Different types of tips apply &adifferent effects&r as well.
chapter.13.quest.58.task.1.title: Any Glass Arrows
chapter.13.quest.6.description.1:
Adding the newly found &aMoonstone Chiseled Blocks&r to the base of your &dSpectrum Palace&r will finally allow you to fully utilize the power allotted to you by the Moonstone upgrade. I'd recommend checking the &6World of Color&r book to reference where to place these blocks.


Right click the pedestal to finish the achievement.
chapter.13.quest.6.title: Finishing Your Palace
chapter.13.quest.60.description.1:
Works very much like its little brother. However, this verison has three chambers, each of which can be filled with a different potion - which also means it can only support effects of level 1.


Use the &ePotion Workshop&r to infuse it, by placing it where the bottle would normally go.


To clear its effect, put it in a crafting grid.
chapter.13.quest.7.description.1: &aHummingstones&r can be found near &2Liquid Crystal&r lakes. They tend to make a tune when &bactivated&r. &oYou wonder what it would a whole lot of them would sound like&r.
chapter.13.quest.8.description.1:
In the &6Deeper Down&r, you can find the remains of &cdragons&r. Unlike the bone structures in the overworld, these&3 cannot be broken&r by any conventional tool.


&oPerhaps a &estrong explosive&r &oyou discovered earlier could suffice?&r
chapter.13.quest.9.description.1: The pretty sounds of the &bHummingstones&r can build each other up until the point in which they shatter in a final anthem. These &ashattered remains&r never seem to stop vibrating, as if they retain some form of &3inherent energy&r.
chapter.13.subtitle: Dig Down and Find Faith
chapter.13.title: &aSpectrum: Turn to Purity&r
chapter.14.image.1: Click to check out the CC:Restitched wiki!
chapter.14.quest.1.description.1: The &aChisel&f mod allows you to add a lot of variety to your builds. The tool itself has &bno durability&f, so feel free to go wild with it.
chapter.14.quest.1.subtitle: King of block variety
chapter.14.quest.10.description.1:
The popular &edirewolf20's Building Gadgets&f have been thankfully ported to &dFabric&f and renamed under &bst'ructure tools&f. These function similarly to the &eBuilding Gadget&f versions and will be insanely helpful in building.


They are pretty powerful, so they are now locked behind &2Electronic Circuits&f.
chapter.14.quest.10.title: Building Gadgets
chapter.14.quest.11.description.1:
This item combo is a modded Minecraft classic. You can charge the &aSlime Sling&f up and it will launch you in the opposite direction. The &bSlime Boots&f will negate all fall damage and cause you to bounce. 


In tandem, you can use it to traverse your world very fast.


I've modified the &bSlime Boots&f to be &dUnbreakable&f, you're welcome.
chapter.14.quest.11.title: Bouncy Transportation
chapter.14.quest.12.description.1:
&aFluid Hoppers&f are quite pricey in their Iron cost, but they will allow you to easily transfer fluids between two containers.


&eModern Industrialization&f pipes are probably better and cheaper than this anyway....
chapter.14.quest.12.subtitle: Moves fluids instead of items!
chapter.14.quest.13.description.1: The &aEscape Rope&f is a quick and easy way to get out of a cave. When used, it teleports you to the highest point above you in the world.
chapter.14.quest.14.description.1: The &aSleeping Bag&f lets you sleep anywhere without overwriting your bed spawn point.
chapter.14.quest.15.description.1: The &aRedstone Timer&f will toggle its output state after a set amount of ticks. You can adjust the delay by right clicking the block.
chapter.14.quest.16.description.1: The &aCobblestone Generator&f does what it says: generates cobblestone. The MK1 is quite slow, but there are upgrades available.
chapter.14.quest.2.description.1: &aDustrial Decor&f is a decorative mod that aims to add an industrial look to your builds. You can view everything you can make with this mod by searching &e@dustrial_decor&f in &dREI&f.
chapter.14.quest.2.subtitle: The factory must grow
chapter.14.quest.2.task.1.title: Click to Acknowledge
chapter.14.quest.2.title: Dustrial Decor
chapter.14.quest.20.subtitle: It's pretty quick
chapter.14.quest.21.description.1: Similar to the &acobblestone generator&f, except this &bgenerates basalt&f. The base version is fairly slow, it would be worth investing in some upgrades.
chapter.14.quest.26.description.1:
The &aDiamond Ring&f is an important crafting material for the other three &eKibe&f rings.


You can only have one ring activated at a time. You will need to remove the rings from your inventory and deactivate them one at a time.
chapter.14.quest.27.description.1: Can be used to place infinite amounts of &elight sources&f. If you've played &aThaumcraft&f before, this is similar to &2Nitor&f.
chapter.14.quest.28.description.1: When activated, the &aMagma Ring&f provides infinite &cFire Resistance&f to the holder.
chapter.14.quest.29.description.1: When activated, the &9Water Ring&f allows the holder to &abreath underwater indefinitely&f.
chapter.14.quest.3.description.1: The &aTarget Dummy&f is pretty self explanatory. You can use this to test how much damage your weapons deal.
chapter.14.quest.3.subtitle: He's not that dumb...
chapter.14.quest.30.description.1: The &aCooler&f automatically will feed the player with the food stored within. It can be placed or opened with shift-right click while holding it.
chapter.14.quest.31.description.1:
&aLassos&f are magical items that can capture entities and later release them in another part of the world.


The &eGolden Lasso&f can only hold passive animals.
chapter.14.quest.32.description.1:
&aLassos&f are magical items that can capture entities and later release them in another part of the world.


The &eDiamond Lasso&f can hold almost any entity without debuffs.
chapter.14.quest.33.description.1:
Fighting the &7Wither&f can be very dangerous and can cause a lot of damage to your world if you're not careful.


Luckily, with these blocks you can automate creating &7Withers&f in cages where they cannot escape. Useful for farming &aNether Stars&f.
chapter.14.quest.33.task.2.title: Any Wither Proof Blocks
chapter.14.quest.33.title: Wither Builder
chapter.14.quest.34.description.1: &eCursed Droplets&f will drop from &aWither Skeletons&f and mobs spawned on &bCursed Dirt&f.
chapter.14.quest.35.description.1:
&aCursed Seeds&f can be used on regular grass or dirt blocks to transform them into &bCursed Dirt&f. The grass and dirt needs to be in darkness for you to convert it. 


&bCursed Dirt&f is a simple grass-like block that burns when exposed to sunlight, but will vastly improve spawn rates of monsters in dark environments.


If you're playing on a server, consider using the &eMob Crusher&f for better performance.
chapter.14.quest.36.description.1: The &aBig Torch&f is a block that cancels any mob spawning that requires no light in a configurable area. It's useful to protect your base and to clean caves and dungeons.
chapter.14.quest.37.description.1:
&aLassos&f are magical items that can capture entities and later release them in another part of the world.


The &8Cursed Lasso&f can hold aggressive entities but will add the curse effect to them upon release.
chapter.14.quest.38.description.1:
&aChimes&f add a nice ambient sound to your base, as well as offering protection from those pesky phantoms! Each type has a different sound, see which one you like best!


Phantoms do not approach/attack players who are near &bchiming wind chimes&f. You can tie/untie a wind chime by crouch + right-clicking the block with an empty hand. Tied Wind Chimes reduce chiming sounds and movement of a Wind Chime, along with allowing Phantoms to approach once again.
chapter.14.quest.38.task.1.title: Any Chimes
chapter.14.quest.38.title: Chimes
chapter.14.quest.39.description.1: This tool can be used to locate resource geodes underground. To use it, place it down on the ground, right click it, and it will attempt to locate a nearby geode.
chapter.14.quest.39.task.1.title: Echo Locator
chapter.14.quest.39.title: Echo Locator
chapter.14.quest.4.description.1:
&aDecorative Blocks&f is a mod designed around simple block additions that can change a lot of the look in your builds.


The support blocks can be interacted with an axe to configure their sides.
chapter.14.quest.4.subtitle: Simple, yet efficient
chapter.14.quest.4.task.1.title: Click to Acknowledge
chapter.14.quest.4.title: Decorative Blocks
chapter.14.quest.40.description.1:
&bCC:Restitched&r is a mod that adds programmable computers to the game. With these you can write custom programs to help with automation, have &aTurtles&r that will mine or farm for you!


It's an extremely complex mod, and definitely has a learning curve. I recommend checking the wiki by clicking the picture to the right of this quest!
chapter.14.quest.40.title: ComputerCraft
chapter.14.quest.41.description.1:
The mod &eSimplySwords&r is included in this pack. In combination with the &bBetterCombat&r mod, it adds a lot of variety to fighting mobs in your world.


&eSimplySwords&r also includes some extremely powerful weapons that can only be found by exploring.
chapter.14.quest.41.subtitle: It's dangerous to go alone!
chapter.14.quest.41.task.1.title: Any SimplySwords Weapons
chapter.14.quest.41.title: SimplySwords
chapter.14.quest.42.description.1:
Find something cool in your world, or just want to take a picture to remember the occasion? Take a picture with the &bCamera&r!


To take a photo, you must have an &aEmpty Map&r in your inventory and press '&eC&r' while using the Camera.
chapter.14.quest.43.description.1: Placers are blocks that, when activated by a redstone signal, will place any block in its inventory in front of it, if possible.
chapter.14.quest.44.description.1: Breakers are blocks that, when activated by a redstone signal, will break any block in front of it and store its drops in its inventory, if possible.
chapter.14.quest.45.description.1: Drawbridges will place the blocks in its inventory directly in front of it when powered by redstone.
chapter.14.quest.46.description.1: The Igniter will light the block in front of it on fire when provided a redstone signal.
chapter.14.quest.47.description.1: Prevents rain / snow particles in a 3x3 chunk radius when powered by redstone.
chapter.14.quest.48.description.1: Melts ice and snow in a 3x3 chunk radius when powered by redstone.
chapter.14.quest.49.description.1: Want to &eshow off&r your skin rather than whatever armor you're currently wearing? You can create the &aClear Armor&r and put in the &3cosmetic armor slots&r to hide the armor you're wearing!
chapter.14.quest.49.task.2.title: Any Clear Armor
chapter.14.quest.49.title: Clear Armor
chapter.14.quest.5.description.1: &aHookshots&f provides a fun new way to explore the world, just be cautious of fall damage!
chapter.14.quest.5.subtitle: Everyone needs a grappling hook
chapter.14.quest.5.task.1.title: Any Hookshot
chapter.14.quest.5.title: Hookshots
chapter.14.quest.50.description.1: &eBuilding Wands&r return! They're &cslightly different&r than you might remember, press '&6y&r' to open their &aconfiguration menu&r while holding one!
chapter.14.quest.51.description.1:
&aCalculators &rare a key to success. With the &dCrafting Calculator&r you can determine how many raw resources a recipe will cost, and how much materials you will need to craft the items in bulk. There is a bit of a &3learning curve&r to the calculator, but it has some helpful tips in it's own UI.


The &2Math Calculator&r works as a general calculator for addition, subtraction, etc.
chapter.14.quest.51.title: Calculators
chapter.14.quest.52.description.1: This mod is a simple port of the &eQuark&r mods &aTrowel&r item. When right clicked it picks a &drandom block&r from your hotbar and places it down.
chapter.14.quest.6.description.1: &aSpice of Fabric&f also adds several containers that can be used to &bcarry multiple types of food&f in one convenient place.
chapter.14.quest.6.subtitle: Your food on the go
chapter.14.quest.6.task.1.title: Any Food Carrier
chapter.14.quest.6.title: Spice of Life Containers
chapter.14.quest.7.description.1: The recipe for the &aBundle&f has been enabled. It can be quite useful for the early game item clutter you may find.
chapter.14.quest.7.subtitle: So vanilla it had to be modded in
chapter.14.quest.8.description.1: Thanks to a mod, the &aTotem of Undying&f can now be equipped in a &etrinket slot&f. This means you can keep your shield in your offhand and not fear death as long as it's equipped.
chapter.14.quest.8.subtitle: Wearable invulnerability
chapter.14.quest.9.description.1: The &aCarry On&f mod is installed in this pack. This means you can shift-right click most tile entities and mobs to &bpick them and carry them around&f. This can be useful if you need to move a chest without breaking it or a pesky pig breaks out of the pen.
chapter.14.quest.9.subtitle: Muscle man
chapter.14.quest.9.task.1.title: Click to Acknowledge
chapter.14.quest.9.title: Carry On
chapter.14.subtitle: Small, but important additions
chapter.14.title: &eUtilities
chapter.2.quest.1.description.1: Pretty much following &evanilla progression&r here for a bit. I'll even give you a bit extra to help build a &2simple shelter&r or some more &9tools&r.
chapter.2.quest.1.subtitle: You're now a caveman!
chapter.2.quest.1.task.1.title: Any Cobblestone
chapter.2.quest.1.title: The Stone Age
chapter.2.quest.10.description.1: The &eHand Crank&r is another alternative form of generating &arotational force&r. Extended use of this will leave the user very &chungry&r, so it's more optimal to have a &eWindmill&r / &eWater Wheel&r generate your power. Great if you just need to &equickly power something&r!
chapter.2.quest.10.subtitle: Manual Labor
chapter.2.quest.11.description.1: &aMetal plates&r are going to be very important moving forward. To make them you're going to need a &eCreate&r &bMechanical Press&r. By placing certain &cingots&r below the press, and supplying the press &arotational force&r on the side, it will start pressing the ingots into &dplates&r!
chapter.2.quest.11.subtitle: Under Pressure
chapter.2.quest.12.description.1:
Creating a &bMechanical Mixer&r and a &bBasin&r will allow you to create &aAndesite Alloy&r for much cheaper. It will also be necessary to progress into the next chapters.


As a quest reward, I've given you a &enew friend&r. Name it whatever you'd like, but know that he's very helpful if you place him &abelow your Basin&r and feed him &cflammable materials&r. This will allow you to use recipes that require the &aBasin&r to be &cHeated&r.
chapter.2.quest.12.subtitle: Mix, swirl, mix
chapter.2.quest.12.title: Mechanical Mixer
chapter.2.quest.13.description.1:
With &6Bronze&r, you can now pretend to be an early 3000 B.C. human!


Combining &craw copper&r and &7raw tin&r in a &aHeated Basin&r will create &6Bronze&r. This is an essential material to early &eModern Industrialization&r.


The ratio for &6Bronze Ingots&r isn't the best in the &eCreate Mixer&r, but you will soon unlock a better ratio with your first steam machines.
chapter.2.quest.13.subtitle: Your first real alloy
chapter.2.quest.13.title: Bronze
chapter.2.quest.14.description.1:
With the &aForge Hammer&r crafted, you have completed your first chapter. The &aForge Hammer&r is essential to progressing in &eModern Industrialization&r.


While also being used to craft &aessential materials&r, it also allows you to &6duplicate your ores&r. Check &dREI&r for everything you can do with it. &eNote&r that &csome ores do not work&r in it, and will &6require a Macerator&r to properly crush!


With this crafted, you &dhave completed the first chapter&r! In the next chapter, you will be moving towards making your own &6Bronze Machines&r!
chapter.2.quest.14.subtitle: More like Fabric Hammer
chapter.2.quest.14.title: The Forge Hammer
chapter.2.quest.15.description.1: &bAndesite Casings&r make up the basis of most &eCreate&r machines. To create an &bAndesite Casing&r, right click with an &eAndesite Alloy&r on any &cStripped Log&r.
chapter.2.quest.16.description.1:
If you can find some cows near where you spawned you can kill them for their leather and make yourself a &eFrayed Backpack&r.


The backpack can be worn on your back and provides &a18 item slots&r. Great for all the stuff you'll be collecting.
chapter.2.quest.17.description.1: Why lug around a crafting table everywhere you go when you could instead make a &ePocket Crafting Table&r. Using this item, you will have access to a 3x3 crafting grid anywhere you go!
chapter.2.quest.18.description.1:
&eSpikes&r will damage any entity that step on it. Each tier has a different effect on the mobs that die from it.


&7Stone Spikes&r - Mobs will drop nothing
&bIron Spikes&r - Mobs will drop their regular loot
&eGold Spikes&r - Mobs will only drop experience
&aDiamond Spikes&r - Mobs will drop both loot and experience


You can create a &erudimentary mob farm&r with these!
chapter.2.quest.18.task.1.title: Any Spikes
chapter.2.quest.18.title: Spikes
chapter.2.quest.19.description.1: &bWooden Buckets&r act just like normal buckets with the only downside being they cannot pick up hot liquids such as &clava&r. Since &aregular buckets&r require &diron plates&r, these will be your friend for the early game!
chapter.2.quest.2.description.1: This is the start to &a99% of any playthrough&r. You can explore the world a bit, but eventually you will need to make some &ebasic tools&r.
chapter.2.quest.2.subtitle: The noble start of any playthrough
chapter.2.quest.2.task.1.title: Any Logs
chapter.2.quest.2.title: Punch Trees
chapter.2.quest.20.description.1: The &bTorch Sling&r uses torches from your inventory as ammo. Torches are placed where they land.
chapter.2.quest.21.description.1:
&6Have too much cobble&r? I wouldn't recommend &ctrashing it&r, but if you really really want to, you can create a &aTrash Can&r to throw away items.


&cBE CAREFUL!&r Items thrown away &cCANNOT&r be restored.
chapter.2.quest.22.description.1: Similar to the &eplaceable&r &aTrash Can&r, but this time it can &dbe opened on the go&r!
chapter.2.quest.23.description.1:
&aDrawers&r are an extremely compact and easy way to &2store a lot of items in a single block&r. The &bbasic drawer&r comes in three different varieties, &dsingle, double, and quad&r. The &eShadow Drawer&r acts similar to a &aDrawer Access Point&r, but allows the player to interact with a single item directly. For example, if you had two separate side-by-side drawers storing 10 logs each, and a shadow drawer set to logs, it will show 20.


The &eCompacting Drawer&r will store compactable blocks, such as iron ingots, and display the total amount of blocks/nuggets.


You can &badd items&r to a drawer by right clicking, and &cremove them&r by left clicking. You can remove stacks at a time from a drawer by &eshift-left clicking&r.


You can apply upgrades and lock drawers by &eshift-right clicking&r the drawer with the upgrade/lock.
chapter.2.quest.23.subtitle: No, not your pants
chapter.2.quest.23.task.1.title: Any Drawer
chapter.2.quest.23.title: Drawers
chapter.2.quest.24.description.1:
&bUpgrades&r are applied using different upgrade items. They increase the capacity of a drawer slot.


To install one, simply &eclick&r on a slot with the upgrade in hand &ewhile sneaking&r.


- &aTier one upgrade&r is 4x the amount that can be stored
- &bTier two upgrade&r is 8x the amount
- &cTier three upgrade&r is 16x the amount
- &dTier four upgrade&r is 32x the amount


The &aDrawer Downgrade&r can be used to &climit&r the capacity of a drawer to a single stack. This can prove useful in automation scenarios.
chapter.2.quest.24.subtitle: MORE MORE MORE
chapter.2.quest.24.task.1.title: Any Drawer Upgrade
chapter.2.quest.24.title: Drawer Upgrades
chapter.2.quest.25.description.1:
&bDrawer Connectors&r are simple blocks that allow you to connect different parts of your drawer network together without wasting resources on drawers.


They also produce &eless lag&r as they don't have to story any data.
chapter.2.quest.26.description.1:
Just by placing some &adrawers&r next to each other you have created a &esimple network&r. However, that &enetwork&r doesn't do anything yet. 


To interact with your &enetwork&r, you can craft an &aaccess point&r. It allows you to insert items into the drawers they belong in &2automatically&r instead of having to do it &cby hand&r.
chapter.2.quest.26.task.1.title: Click to Acknowledge
chapter.2.quest.26.title: Drawer Networks
chapter.2.quest.27.description.1:
&bAccess Points&r allow inserting items to the &awhole network&r, automatically finding the right drawer.


They also act as an &einterface&r for other mods to access the network.


You can lock/unlock your entire network by &eshift-right clicking&r with a lock on the access point
chapter.2.quest.28.description.1:
&bVoiding mode&r can be toggled with a &elava bucket&r. It makes it so that the drawer &cdeletes excess items&r.


This is mostly useful when you have &ebulk storage&r for a very &3common item&r and don't want it to &cclog the system when it fills up&r.


Like locks, they &aaren't consumed&r and can be applied to &daccess points&r. &cBe careful as it can easily void important items if used improperly&r. Also make sure to &2aim well&r, or you might end up placing the &clava&r instead.
chapter.2.quest.28.subtitle: Playing with fire
chapter.2.quest.28.title: Voiding Mode
chapter.2.quest.29.description.1:
&aHidden mode&r can be toggled with a &eblack dye&r. It makes it so that the drawer doesn't show it's item.


This is mostly useful when you have a big network of drawers and want to improve performance as rendering the item icons can be very expensive.


Like locks, the items &baren't consumed&r and can be applied to &eaccess points&r.


&aHiding&r can also be applied to &eshadow drawers&r. This is mostly useful if you want to use one in a contraption.
chapter.2.quest.29.title: Hidden Mode
chapter.2.quest.3.description.1:
The early game of this pack is focused around the &eCreate&r mod. For this, you will need a lot of &aAndesite&r. Luckily, this quest rewards you with &esome extra&r. Once you have a &6Bronze Mixer&r you will unlock a recipe to make &aAndesite&r renewable!


For those of you who don't like &eCreate&r, I've kept the &eCreate&r &crequirements low&r for the pack. You can &bchoose&r to pursue &eCreate&r further after you pass the parts where it is required, but &6fully progressing&r in &eCreate&r &cis not needed&r to beat the pack.
chapter.2.quest.3.title: Prepare for Create
chapter.2.quest.30.description.1:
&aTom's Simple Storage Mod&r is going to be a godsend for the early game, as you won't have access to an &eApplied Energistics 2&r network until &2Electronic Circuits&r.


The &bInventory Connector&r acts similarly to the &cAE2 Controller&r. It's the heart of an inventory network. You can connect terminals to the &bInventory Connector&r to access all the linked inventories.
chapter.2.quest.30.title: Tom's Simple Storage Mod
chapter.2.quest.31.description.1: The &aStorage Terminal&r can be connected to the &bInventory Connector&r to display all the linked inventories and access all the items.
chapter.2.quest.32.description.1: The &aCrafting Terminal&r is an upgraded terminal that allows you to craft while accessing your inventory network. Pretty much similar to the &cAE2 Crafting Terminal&r.
chapter.2.quest.33.description.1: The &bWireless Terminal&r is an item that can be used to remotely access your &aInventory Terminals&r. To use, hold the &bWireless Terminal&r and aim at an terminal on your network, you'll need to be within 16 blocks to do so.
chapter.2.quest.34.description.1:
&2Inventory Cables&r can extend the range of your inventory connection. Use an &bInventory Cable Connector&r to link the inventory to the cable.


It's much cheaper to use &aInventory Trims&r to connect to your &eInventory Connector&r, but the &bCable Connectors&r are great when something is far away!
chapter.2.quest.34.subtitle: Connect all the things!
chapter.2.quest.34.title: Inventory Cables
chapter.2.quest.35.description.1:
The &aAdvanced Wireless Terminal&r allows you to access your network without having to be nearby and looking at the terminal. &eShift-right click&r a terminal to bind to it.


Placing a &ctier 1 beacon&r near the bound terminal will allow you to access the inventory anywhere in the current dimension.
Placing a full &ctier 4 beacon&r near the bound terminal will allow you to access the inventory anywhere, even across dimensions. 


The &echunks&r the inventories are in will &eneed to be loaded&r to access them remotely.
chapter.2.quest.36.description.1: The &aInventory Trim&r can be used to connect other inventories to your &eInventory Connector&r. Place a &aTrim&r connecting from the &eInventory Connector&r to chest/barrels/etc to &3link it all up&r!
chapter.2.quest.37.description.1:
The &aBasic Inventory Hopper&r can import or export from your inventory network.


&eRight click&r to set the filter, &eshift-right click&r with an empty hand to clear the filter.
chapter.2.quest.38.description.1: Emits redstone signals based on your inventory storage. Similar to the &eAE2 Level Emitter&r.
chapter.2.quest.39.description.1:
While traversing your world you might have noticed &3small pebbles&r placed around the surface called &dSamples&r. These &dSamples&r are indicative of a &elarger ore deposit&r below them. That's right, &2GregTech-like oregen&r is in this pack and you will need to find varying &eore deposits&r to gather the materials you will need to progress. Don't worry, once you find one it will last awhile. Also it is worth noting that &cthere aren't many types of ores for a single type of material&r. An &aIron Vein&r will have &aIron Ore&r, and no other &cIron Ore-like&r ores like &2GregTech&r.


To make finding these &eore deposits&r easier, there is the &6Prospector Pick&r. Right clicking with this will show you a notification of what &aores can be found nearby or below you&r. 


&cNeed to find a specific ore&r? You can click the block in &dREI&r and check the &binformation tab&r to see which &eore vein&r it spawns in. For example, this is what that tab looks like for &3Nickel Ore&r:
chapter.2.quest.39.description.2:
A complete breakdown of these values is as follows:
- &3Range&r: the &ay-level range&r the vein can generate
- &2Size&r: the &bsize of the vein&r, &cdoes not correlate to how many blocks are in the vein&r
- &dDimension&r: which &edimension&r the vein can be found
- &bBiome&r: which &6biome&r the vein can be found
- &9Weight&r: the generation &3weight&r of this specific vein
- &6Blocks&r: the &aores within the vein&r and their &3generation rate within the vein&r


&bPlease note you might have to scroll to see all ores in a vein&r.


Also note that the tooltips on the &aore blocks&r are &cmisleading&r, only trust the &ainformation from the information panel&r.


The only ores not changed are from &dSpectrum&r
chapter.2.quest.39.subtitle: Giant ore veins return!
chapter.2.quest.39.task.1.title: Click to Acknowledge
chapter.2.quest.39.title: Time to Mine!
chapter.2.quest.4.description.1:
&bAndesite Alloy&r is the most important material you will need for early game &eCreate&r. The crafting cost can be a &alittle steep at first&r, but once you create a &aMixer&r the cost will &2drop significantly&r.


The &cWrench&r and &cGoggles&r will be your &6essential tools&r when using the &eCreate&r mod. The &cWrench&r allows you to &ashift-right click&r to &ainstantly harvest&r any &eCreate&r block, &aright-click&r to rotate, or adjust certain settings on a block. The &cGoggles&r, when worn, will allow you to see the &dtotal stress units&r used / available.
chapter.2.quest.4.title: Andesite Alloy
chapter.2.quest.40.description.1:
Tired of having to chop down trees &cblock by block&r? &eStress no longer&r, the &aLumberaxe&r is here to save the day. 


These tools act similar to a &dvein miner&r effect, and will destroy &3any connected logs&r to the log you break with it. &cWARNING&r: This does include logs &cplaced by hand&r!
chapter.2.quest.40.task.1.title: Lumberaxes
chapter.2.quest.41.description.1: While mining &cblock by block&r through a &2large ore deposit&r sure is fun (&oNOT!&r), it's much better mining in a &a3x3 area&r! Each tier of &eHammer&r increases its &3mining speed&r and &ddurability&r. These will be an essential tool moving forward!
chapter.2.quest.41.subtitle: HAMMAH DOWN
chapter.2.quest.41.task.1.title: Hammers
chapter.2.quest.42.description.1: Need more &dstress units&r and don't care about speed? Rather than divulging a lot of resources into a &eWind Mill&r, you can instead create &aLarge Water Wheels&r. They will provide &d512 stress units&r, &cbut provide half the rotational speed&r of the smaller counterpart.
chapter.2.quest.42.subtitle: Rise and Shine!
chapter.2.quest.43.description.1: Unfortunately, &eTinker's Construct&r is not in the pack, however it's &aCrafting Station&r has been added by &6Enhanced Workbenches&r mod. It doesn't appear that it currently can pull from adjacent inventories, &2but it might in the future&r! For now it just retains your items after you close it (&obut wait the default one does that too&r?)
chapter.2.quest.44.description.1:
Now here's something more worth your time from the &eEnhanced Workbenches&r mod. The &aProject Table&r is based off of &6RedPower 2&r's implementation and features &2two rows of storage&r within the block itself. This is going to be very helpful as you move into &eModern Industrialization&r and have to deal with &dmicrocrafting&r.


&oI've also asked the dev kindly to add the recipe history feature from things like the Forestry Workbench, so maybe someday!&r
chapter.2.quest.44.subtitle: An early game best friend
chapter.2.quest.5.description.1: &aWater Wheels&r make up the basis of your early game rotational force production. If you aren't familiar with &eCreate&r's "power" generation, I recommend checking the &bPonder&r menu by holding &bW&r on the &eCreate&r items you've made so far.
chapter.2.quest.5.subtitle: You spin me right round
chapter.2.quest.5.title: Rotational Power
chapter.2.quest.6.description.1: While the &arotational speed&r of the water wheel is decent, they don't provide a high &bstress unit&r capacity. If you're constantly &coverstressing&r your machines, perhaps you should invest in some &eWindmills&r. These fantastic rotational power generators offer some of the best in terms of &bstress unit&r capacity.
chapter.2.quest.6.subtitle: High stress, low speed
chapter.2.quest.6.title: Windmill
chapter.2.quest.7.description.1:
&aCogs&r are the basis of &erotational power&r in the &eCreate&r mod. You will need them to transfer &bkinetic forces&r from your generators to your &eCreate&r machines. 


Don't worry, we'll make a generator to use soon enough.
chapter.2.quest.7.subtitle: CogChamp
chapter.2.quest.7.title: Big and Little Cogs
chapter.2.quest.8.description.1:
Before you continue, it's pivotal to know how the &arotation&r and &bstress&r units work in &eCreate&r.


The mod developers of &eCreate&r spent a lot of time creating a wonderful in-game tutorial system called &aPonder&r. If you look in &bREI&r, or have &eCreate&r items in your inventory, you can hold &aW&r to "&aPonder&r" the item to view a nice in-game diagram of how it's used.


As a basic breakdown, &bstress units&r are the total amount of &bstress&r your &drotational network&r (cogs, shafts, machines, etc.) can handle. &aRotational speed&r is how fast the shafts/cogs spin in your &dnetwork&r and how fast your machines run. &eHigher rotational power&r incurs a &ehigher amount of stress units&r to compensate.
chapter.2.quest.8.task.1.title: Click to Acknowledge
chapter.2.quest.8.title: Stress Units and Rotational Force
chapter.2.quest.9.description.1:
You can use &bcogwheels&r to increase the &erotation speed&r by connecting a &asmaller cogwheel&r to a &alarge cogwheel&r. You can then attach another &alarge cogwheel&r to the front of the &bsmall cogwheel&r and continue the process. Doing this will &eincrease&r the overall rotation speed. Doing the inverse will &clower&r the speed. 


Note that &eincreases&r the rotational speed will also mean your machines &crequire&r more stress units on the network to operate.


The quest rewards grants a free &eSpeedometer&r. Attaching this to your shafts/gears will show you to &aRPM&r of your &eCreate&r network. You can place the &eSpeedometer&r in a crafting table to convert it into a &eStressometer&r. Placing this one your network will show you the total &bstress units&r your &eCreate&r network can support.
chapter.2.quest.9.task.1.title: Click to Acknowledge
chapter.2.quest.9.title: Increase/Decrease Rotation Speed
chapter.2.subtitle: Gotta start somewhere
chapter.2.title: &b1 - Getting Started
chapter.3.quest.1.description.1:
Welcome to &eChapter 2&r.


The majority of this chapter will be focused on getting your first &6Bronze Machines&r and &eSteel Ingots&r using &7steam&r as power.
chapter.3.quest.10.description.1:
Now that you have a &6Bronze Boiler&r built, you can use it to power other &7steam&r machines. The &6boiler&r will automatically produce and send &7steam&r to &aadjacent machines&r, up to 8 millibuckets per tick. 


&6Bronze machines&r can only process recipes up to 2 EU/t. 1mB of &7steam&r is equivalent to 1 EU, meaning a &6boiler&r at &cmax temperature&r can power &e4 machines simultaneously&r.


&7Steam Machines&r will &2accept inputs from any side&r, be it items, &7steam&r or another fluid. You can &6lock their slots by clicking on the lock in the interface&r. &2Locked slots only accept one type of item or fluid&r.


Every machine has an &coutput side&r, and you can enable&e auto-output&r from the interface. Hoppers, pipes, and other automation can &2extract output items from any side&r, of course. You can also &breduce the maximum number of items in a slot by scrolling&r.


Using a &ewrench&r, you can rotate any machine by right-clicking. You can &3rotate the output side&r by sneaking while you shift-click.


&cNOTE&r: Breaking a machine with the &ewrench&r &cWILL NOT drop it&r. &aUse a pickaxe for that&r!
chapter.3.quest.10.task.1.title: Click to Acknowledge
chapter.3.quest.10.title: Interacting with Machines
chapter.3.quest.100.description.1: Use an &aEmpty Bucket&b on the &eXP Storage&r to fill it. You can right click with a full bucket to empty it into the &eXP Storage&r.
chapter.3.quest.101.description.1:
Prefer a more &6Thermal Dynamics&r style for your pipes? Unlike &eMI&r pipes, these &cdo not transfer fluids instantly&r, however their price makes them useful when you need a &dcheap solution to moving a fluid&r.


&6Pipes&r won't move fluids unless you have an &battachment&r to the pipe or a machine is &3auto ejecting&r into it. 


They can be interacted with using the &eModern Industrialization&r &6Wrench&r.


&cBe wary of using these extensively on a server&r, as they are significantly more laggy than MI pipes.
chapter.3.quest.101.title: Modern Dynamics Fluid Pipes
chapter.3.quest.102.description.1:
&eAttachments&r can be right-clicked on &3pipe connections&r to configure the IO of the pipes.


&6Extractor&r: Will extract from adjacent inventories


&3Attractor&r: Will allow the pipe to pull from connected inventories. Applying this on a pipe will increase the flow rate of the pipe. 


&2Filter&r: Allows for configuration for the connected inventory.
chapter.3.quest.102.title: Modern Dynamics Attachments
chapter.3.quest.103.description.1:
Similar to the &eFluid Pipe&r you unlocked earlier, the &aItem Pipe&r from &6Modern Dynamics&r allows for a more classic style of item transfer. 


Items are &cnot transferred instantaneously&r and can be seen flowing from connections. The &3attachments&r for the &eFluid Pipe&r also work with the &aItem Pipe&r and will be needed to actually extract things. By default, items will path towards the &dnearest inventory&r in the pipe.
chapter.3.quest.103.title: Modern Dynamics Item Pipe
chapter.3.quest.104.description.1: &aItem Pipes&r build a path to their connections based on the distance between them. Using an &6Inhibitor&r will increase the path distance calculation for that attachment by &31000&r. Great for making a connection that will be &cavoided&r.
chapter.3.quest.105.description.1: If you plan to use &eModern Dynamic&r pipes with your &6Modern Industrialization&r machines, you will quickly notice you &crun out of faces&r to plug the pipes into. Luckily, the &2Machine Extender&r has your back. To explain it simply, it &dextends the connection&r to the machine into itself, allowing you to &bconnect pipes to it that will count as a connection to the machine&r.
chapter.3.quest.106.description.1:
By adding some &6Sulfur Dust&r to the &aSynthetic Oil&r you can create &eSynthetic Rubber&r, which is &26x more efficient&r for making &dRubber Sheets&r.


&6Sulfur Dust&r can be easily obtained by macerating &bLignite Coal Ore&r.
chapter.3.quest.106.title: More Efficient Rubber
chapter.3.quest.107.description.1:
This tiny little thing is the &efirst tier&r of &aDanks&r you have access to. What is a &aDank&r you might ask? Think of it as an &2extremely powerful backpack&r. 


This &aTier 1 Dank&r has &d9 slots&r and each can hold a stacksize of &6256 items&r.


In addition to it's storage, it has options to &9automatically pickup blocks&r, &3pickup from a filter&r, or &dvoid blocks&r. Think of all that Cobblestone you no longer have to sort through in your inventory!
chapter.3.quest.107.subtitle: Dank Storage!
chapter.3.quest.108.description.1: With &cCopper Plates&r, you can upgrade your normal barrels to &ehold more items&r. This one can store up to &236 stacks of items&r.
chapter.3.quest.109.description.1: The &7Iron Barrel&r can store &254 stacks of items&r.
chapter.3.quest.11.description.1:
&aPipes&r are used in the recipes of some machines, but they can also be &6placed in the world&r. &eUp to 3 different pipes / cables can fit in a single block&r.


&aPipes&r of different colors will &cnot&r connect.


Right-clicking a &apipe&r with a &ewrench&r will change the connection type, shift-right-clicking will &6drop the pipe&r. You can also &aadjust the connection&r by right-clicking the connection with your hand. You can also connect &apipes&r to machines by holding &6shift and right-clicking&r while holding a &apipe&r in your hand while &efacing the machine face&r you'd like to connect to.


&aFluid Pipes&r can only contain &2one type of fluid&r, and by default they &3won't connect to empty pipes or blocks&r. You can force a connection by right-clicking the center of the pipe with the wrench, or by &2right-clicking a block with a pipe in your hand&r: it will connect, but &cnot consume&r the item in your hand.


Every tick, &aFluid Pipes&r will try to evenly extract for all connected blocks, and then try to insert that evenly.
chapter.3.quest.11.subtitle: Let the spaghetti commence
chapter.3.quest.11.task.1.title: Any MI Fluid Pipe
chapter.3.quest.11.title: Fluid Pipes
chapter.3.quest.110.description.1: The &eGold Barrel&r stores &266 stacks of items&r. This is the highest tier you can make until you can process &bDiamond Plates&r.
chapter.3.quest.111.description.1:
Want something to move &afluids&r manually &ebetween machines&r a little easier? The &6TechReborn&r &3Fluid Cells&r act similar to &dIC2 Fluid Cells&r and allow you to pick up and move fluids between &bmachine GUIs&r. 


Only certain fluids can be placed from cells.
chapter.3.quest.111.subtitle: Manual Labor
chapter.3.quest.112.description.1:
Tired on waiting for those &evanilla furnaces&r to take forever to smelt down your &6ores&r and &2dusts&r? The &aLarge Steam Furnace&r is the solution. This multiblock is capable of &dsmelting 8 items at once for the cost of one&r. This makes it &3extremely efficient&r and an very handy tool if you need to mass smelt stuff and don't want to dive into &eCreate&r!


If you're having trouble forming the multiblock, hold W on the &aLarge Steam Furnace&r in your inventory to view the &bPonder&r scene for the multiblock, additionally you can hold the &eWrench&r to see the missing blocks and the errors. You can also hold a hatch to know where it can go.
chapter.3.quest.112.subtitle: Extremely efficient!
chapter.3.quest.112.task.4.title: Any Item Input Hatch
chapter.3.quest.112.task.5.title: Any Item Output Hatch
chapter.3.quest.112.task.6.title: Any Fluid Input Hatch
chapter.3.quest.113.description.1:
The &aLarge Steam Macerator&r can &eprocess eight items&r in the&6 time it would take to process two&r, while only costing &d4 EU/t&r &o(4mb Steam/t)&r!


If you're having trouble forming the multiblock, hold W on the &aLarge Steam Macerator&r in your inventory to view the &bPonder&r scene for the multiblock, additionally you can hold the &eWrench&r to see the missing blocks and the errors. You can also hold a hatch to know where it can go.
chapter.3.quest.113.subtitle: Even more efficient!
chapter.3.quest.113.task.5.title: Any Item Input Hatch
chapter.3.quest.113.task.6.title: Any Item Output Hatch
chapter.3.quest.113.task.7.title: Any Fluid Input Hatch
chapter.3.quest.114.description.1:
The &aPortable Storage Unit&r can be crafted to transport energy in your inventory. It can be charged and discharged by right-clicking on &2any tier of storage unit&r.


By default, &cit has no energy storage capacity&r. To &3add capacity&r, you need to fill it with &dbatteries&r by either right-clicking on the &aPSU&r with &dbatteries&r or by right-clicking on a &dbattery&r while holding the &aPSU&r. 


The &bhigher level the batteries&r are, the &3more capacity&r they will add to the storage. You can get the &dbattery&r back by right-clicking on an empty slot with the &aPSU&r, but be warned, &cany excess energy will be lost&r!


&cNo, it cannot be used to charge things in your inventory&r. If you want/need that make the Red Cell Battery from &eTechReborn&r.
chapter.3.quest.115.description.1:
Your machines might be &ctoo noisy&r for your liking. If you want to &asilence&r them, you can craft a &6Steel Mallet&r and &3right click&r to &asilence/unsilence&r them. It has &dno durability&r, so feel free to use it however you like.


If you'd rather &badjust sounds&r, you can always change them with the &2Extreme Sound Muffler&r GUI in your inventory.
chapter.3.quest.116.description.1: The &aRedstone Control Module&r is an upgrade for your machines that allows you to control when they run using &credstone&r. By defualt, the module is operating with &6High Power&r. This means that the machine &bwill not run&r unless it's given a &cRedstone signal&r. You can invert this by &3shift+right clicking&r the &aRedstone Control Module&r in your hand. Doing so puts it in &6Low Power&r mode, which means the machine &bwill only run&r when not powered by a &cRedstone signal&r.
chapter.3.quest.116.subtitle: Fine tuned control
chapter.3.quest.117.description.1: The &aAdvanced Magnet&r is an upgrade to the basic &bMagnet&r that allows &dgreater range&r and &3filtering&r
chapter.3.quest.12.description.1:
Each &afluid pipe&r has an &einternal buffer&r of exactly one bucket (1000 millibuckets). When you connect multiple pipes directly, they become linked and &2share their internal storage&r. 


How much fluid is transferred every tick is then &6bounded by the total capacity of the network&r. For example, 25 fluid pipes linked together can transfer up to &d25000 mb/t of fluid&r - assuming you can produce that much fluid of course!


Note that you might be limited by the &etransfer rates of the tanks/machines&r the pipes are connected to.
chapter.3.quest.12.task.1.title: Click to Acknowledge
chapter.3.quest.12.title: Fluid Pipe Speed
chapter.3.quest.13.description.1: The &6Bronze Macerator&r is a helpful machine to help you get more value out of the &aores&r you mine. Processing &aores&r will grant you additional &ddusts&r which can be smelted into ingots.
chapter.3.quest.13.subtitle: More bang for your buck
chapter.3.quest.14.description.1:
The &6Bronze Compressor&r will turn ingots into plates at a 1:1 ratio. It can also turn each double ingot into 2 plates.


&eCreate&r's &aMechanical Press&r is not powerful enough for some recipes, so you will want to craft one of these.


&eI would recommend making this as soon as possible.&r
chapter.3.quest.14.subtitle: Smoosh
chapter.3.quest.15.description.1: The &6Bronze Furnace&r is a furnace that accepts &7steam&r instead of &atraditional fuels&r. It is as slow as a normal furnace, but is 10 times &3more fuel efficient&r due to using &7Steam&r.
chapter.3.quest.15.subtitle: A more efficient furnace
chapter.3.quest.16.description.1: The &6Bronze Mixer&r will help you &amix dusts&r, giving you a better ratio for &6Bronze&r and &aFire Clay&r, as well as opening up a recipe for &eUncooked Steel&r. It can also create &dCobblestone&r and &3Clay&r.
chapter.3.quest.16.subtitle: Mixing it up!
chapter.3.quest.17.description.1:
The &6Bronze Cutting Machine&r will give you &ebetter ratios&r for bolts, gears, rings and rods. It uses a little bit of &6lubricant&r every time.


The &6Cutting Machine&r is also useful for automatically chiseling blocks, getting better ratios for wood, and many other things. Check out the &dREI&r recipes for it, it's quite expansive!


Until you have a &aCoke Oven&r, you don't have any &6Lubricant,&r so maybe wait until you have access to Creosote before making this?
chapter.3.quest.17.subtitle: Bzzzzz
chapter.3.quest.18.description.1:
Once you have had enough of the &6bronze machines&r, you can start working toward making &eSteel&r. The ultimate goal is to be able to build the &2Steam Quarry&r, a &emultiblock that will dig ores for you&r.


The first step in &eSteel&r production is to make &bCoke&r by heating coal without oxygen. To do this, you will need to make the &aCoke Oven&r multiblock. &eThe block requirements for building this match directly to the requirements of this quest&r.


The &aCoke Oven&r block has the role of the &2controller&r for the multiblock. &eEvery multiblock is managed by a controller&r, but you usually &ccannot I/O from the controller directly&r: all input and output goes through &ahatches&r. We need a &2Fluid Input Hatch&r because the &aCoke Oven&r is powered by &7steam&r, we need an item input for the coal and output for the coke.


If you're having trouble forming the multiblock, hold W on the &aCoke Oven&r in your inventory to view the &bPonder&r scene for the multiblock, additionally you can hold the &eWrench&r to see the missing blocks and the errors. You can also hold a hatch to know where it can go.


Once the &aCoke Oven&r says &dShape Valid&r, fill the fluid input hatch with &7Steam&r, put Coal in the &3Item Input Hatch&r and you're good to go!


Coke will be very useful for &eSteel&r, but it also is a powerful fuel as it lasts four times as long as coal.
chapter.3.quest.18.subtitle: Your first multiblock machine!
chapter.3.quest.18.task.3.title: Any Item Input Hatch
chapter.3.quest.18.task.4.title: Any Item Output Hatch
chapter.3.quest.18.task.5.title: Any Fluid Input Hatch
chapter.3.quest.18.title: The Coke Oven
chapter.3.quest.19.description.1: Individually &dBricks&r need to be packaged down into &2Brick blocks&r. You can do this for now with a &6Bronze Compressor&r, but it's rather slow and you'll want to use a &eSteel Packer&r once it's available for a quicker recipe.
chapter.3.quest.2.description.1:
Now you may want to consider creating a &aSteam Mining Drill&r to obtain the ores directly without needing a Silk Touch pickaxe.


The &aSteam Mining Drill&r can mine 3x3 blocks at the time, perfect for your early game mining needs. The &aSteam Mining Drill&r requires both &9water&r and solid fuel (for example coal).


Right-click a &9water&r source to fill it with water, and make sure to place some fuel in your drill by &2right-clicking the fuel items on it in your inventory&r. The &9water&r block is not consumed to fill the drill, but will be drained alongside the fuel when it is used to mine.
chapter.3.quest.2.subtitle: 3x3 with Silk Touch
chapter.3.quest.20.description.1:
You may have noticed in the recipe for Coke that you have a chance to get &aCreosote&r. By default, since we didn't attach a &2Fluid Output Hatch&r, this fluid is &cvoided&r in the process in the &aCoke Oven&r.


&aCreosote&r can prove to be very useful, such as being able to make &6Lubricant&r for your &6Cutting Machines&r. If you'd like to start storing &aCreosote&r, attach a &2Fluid Output Hatch&r to the &aCoke Oven&r and pipe the fluid into tanks.
chapter.3.quest.21.description.1: By combining &3Creosote&r with &cRedstone Dust&r in a mixer you can create &6Lubricant&r. This fluid will be very useful in use of a &6Cutting Machine&r.
chapter.3.quest.22.description.1: With multiblocks from &eModern Industrialization&r, you can share a wall between two separate multiblocks to save on some resources. You cannot place hatches on the shared wall, as it will not form the multiblock if you do so.
chapter.3.quest.22.task.1.title: Click to Acknowledge
chapter.3.quest.22.title: Wall Sharing
chapter.3.quest.23.description.1: Mixing your newly created &aCoke Dust&r with &3Iron Dust&r in a &6Mixer&r you can make &eUncooked Steel Dust&r. This is the precursor for &eSteel&r, now you will&2 need another multiblock to smelt it&r!
chapter.3.quest.23.title: Uncooked Steel Dust
chapter.3.quest.24.description.1:
&aCoke&r is a heavily improved version of &ccoal&r. It's &24x as powerful&r as regular &ccoal,&r and is a key component in creating &eSteel&r.


To make &eCoke Dust&r, you will need to pass regular &aCoke&r through a &6Macerator&r.
chapter.3.quest.24.subtitle: Not the soda
chapter.3.quest.25.description.1:
To turn your &eUncooked Steel&r Dust into &eSteel Ingots&r, you will need a &2Blast Furnace&r. For now your &2Blast Furnace&r will be powered off of &7steam&r. 


You will need the same amount of materials in the quest requirements to build the &2Steam Blast Furnace&r. It's structure is very similar to the &aCoke Oven&r's with &cBricks&r being replaced by &eFire Clay Bricks&r and one extra hollow layer on top. Like before, if you forget how to build the multiblock, you can always hold your wrench to see it or hold 'W' on the &aSteam Blast Furnace&r item to view it's &bPonder&r scene.
chapter.3.quest.25.subtitle: Better than the vanilla version!
chapter.3.quest.25.task.3.title: Any Item Input Hatch
chapter.3.quest.25.task.4.title: Any Item Output Hatch
